text:
anya: heads-up: discovered a reproducible KV-index tilt when running long-context onboarding for redwood-13b-int8 on prompts that interleave short system messages with very long user history (~45k tokens). it manifests as a subtle punctuation duplication and then a sustained semantic drift after the tilt point.

drew: can you share a tiny repro and logs? is this on rescaled RoPE or legacy?

anya: repro below. rescaled RoPE + packed-phase table (quant pipeline). float16/unpacked-phase clean. toggling kv_shard_merge only changes where the tilt happens, not whether it happens.

```
# local repro
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-int8-packphi","input":"<system>\n<user history repeated to 45k>\n<system short>\n"}' > out.json
jq .out[44860:44896] out.json
```

anya: output snippet shows: repeated comma then unexpected newline then drift. logs:

```
[2026-08-02T10:12:31Z] INFO decode tok=44864 kv_idx=44864 phase=0.9983
[2026-08-02T10:12:32Z] INFO decode tok=44865 kv_idx=44865 phase=0.9983
[2026-08-02T10:12:33Z] INFO decode tok=44866 kv_idx=44865 phase=0.3341  # tilt: kv_idx stuck, phase low
[2026-08-02T10:12:33Z] WARN kv: interleaved-prefix-tilt tok=44866 delta_kv=-1
```

martin: delta_kv=-1 again. but interleaved system messages make me suspect our pad-aware pos compute + packed-phase quantization path: we compute a block-offset per shard and then pack phases; the short system lines cause small nonuniform increments that, when packed, lose low-order phase residuals and can flip the index mask.

drew: did you try forcing rotary_precompute=false or disabling phase packing?

anya: yes: disabling pack fixes it; rotary_precompute=false shifts onset by a few tokens but still fails. also repro disappears if we disable kv_shard_merge (single-shard mode) suggesting a subtle cross-shard offset rounding.

ci-bot: build 2026.08.02-quantpack completed on branch quant/pack-phase-tilt  tests: 225 passed, 6 flaky (longctx).

martin: plan: (1) make pad-aware pos computation use 64-bit fixed-point before packing so we don't lose residuals, (2) add per-shard high-order delta to packed blocks (cheap) so shard merges can recover low bits, (3) unit test that fuzzes interleaved short-system messages with histories to 100k tokens.

drew: also add a production metric to detect kv_idx non-monotonicity and a sampled trace when it occurs. metric: kv_idx_nonmono_total and sample kv_trace_on_nonmono.

anya: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/rt-runtime/pull/5233 with guarded pad-aware fixed-point precompute + shard-delta entries and a longctx-quant pack smoke. includes repro and microbench. local perf: guarded fixes ~0.5% throughput hit on short runs, negligible on long runs.

ops-bot: scheduled staging longctx-48h with int8-packphi + interleaved-prefix harness once CI green.

martin: if PR passes, backport candidate for stable-2026.07 since we have customer trace RD-3793 showing similar punctuation duplication.

drew: +1 for backport. please include the sample kv_trace_on_nonmono in the PR for SRE consumption.

anya: will add metric + alert (kv_idx_nonmono_rate > 1/hour/node) and schedule the staging run. thanks all :thumbsup:

ci-bot: PR 5233 opened by anya. CI: longctx-quant-pack queued.
